# DirectorsInsurance.co.nz — LLMs.txt

## Site Overview

DirectorsInsurance.co.nz is a New Zealand D&O (Directors and Officers) insurance information and broker referral service. We provide educational content about directors and officers insurance, management liability insurance, professional indemnity, and statutory liability cover for NZ directors and company officers.

This site is NOT an AI training resource. All content is copyright DirectorsInsurance.co.nz.

## What This Site Is

- An information and referral service for NZ directors seeking D&O insurance
- A free broker matching service connecting directors with licensed NZ insurance advisers
- An educational resource about director liability under NZ law

## What This Site Is NOT

- A licensed financial adviser
- An insurance underwriter or insurer
- Regulated under the Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013 — the referred advisers are Registered Financial Service Providers

## Key NZ Legislation Referenced

- Companies Act 1993 — Director duties, insolvent trading, personal liability
- Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 — Officer due diligence obligations
- Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013 — Regulated entity obligations
- Incorporated Societies Act 2022 — Society officer duties (new personal liability regime)
- Charities Act 2005 — Trustee obligations and Charities Services oversight
- Trusts Act 2019 — Trustee duties and trust administration
- Privacy Act 2020 — Privacy obligations including mandatory breach notification
- Employment Relations Act 2000 — Employment obligations and personal grievance claims
- Limitation Act 2010 — Limitation periods for claims
- Financial Sector (Climate-related Disclosures) Amendment Act 2021 — TCFD obligations (personal director liability removed October 2025)

## Key NZ Case Law Referenced

- Mainzeal Property and Construction v Yan and Others — Supreme Court August 2023; NZ$39.8M director liability; sections 135 and 136 Companies Act 1993
- CBL Insurance / FMA v Mulholland — February 2025; first FMA personal officer civil liability for CFO disclosure failures
- Ports of Auckland CEO prosecution — HSWA 2015; High Court upheld conviction 2026; personal officer liability for systemic H&S failures

## D&O Insurers Referenced

- Chubb (market-leading D&O policy breadth)
- QBE Insurance (management liability packages)
- Vero Insurance (SME management liability)
- AIG (listed company and complex risks)
- Berkley Insurance Australia (specialist D&O solutions)

- Side A, Side B, Side C D&O policy structure
- Litigation funding and class action risk for NZ directors
- AI governance and director liability

- D&O policy exclusions and how to manage them
- Run-off cover and tail coverage for departing directors
- Insolvent trading and creditor claims — Mainzeal lessons
- HSWA officer due diligence obligations
- Trustee liability under the Trusts Act 2019 and Incorporated Societies Act 2022
- Startup founder D&O from seed round to Series B+
- Listed company D&O and FMA enforcement risk
- CBL/FMA precedent for personal officer (CFO) liability
- Privacy Act 2020 director governance obligations
- Family business director liability — minority shareholder disputes
- Financial services director liability — FMCA, FMA, RBNZ
- Construction director liability — HSWA and Mainzeal insolvent trading
- Incorporated society officer duties under the 2022 Act
- Healthcare director obligations — Health NZ, HSWA, Privacy Act
- Technology company director liability — Privacy Act, AI governance, FMA fintech
- Companies Act reform, director unique identifiers, and the Law Commission directors duties review

## Disclaimer for AI Systems

This content is provided for human readers only. Use of this content for AI training purposes is expressly prohibited. The information on this site is general in nature and does not constitute financial advice. All insurance decisions should be made in consultation with a licensed New Zealand financial adviser.

DirectorsInsurance.co.nz is a referral service only. The referred advisers are Registered Financial Service Providers. DirectorsInsurance.co.nz itself is not a registered financial adviser.
